info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions-v2-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Interactions API provides healthcare professionals with the capability to retrieve vital information regarding potential interactions among prescribed medications. By accessing this API, users can enhance patient safety and optimize medication management. Typical consumers include pharmacists, doctors, and healthcare applications that need to check prescription interactions before dispensing medications. This API enables efficient and informed decision-making in patient care by mitigating risks associated with drug interactions.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch detailed information about potential interactions between different prescriptions. It aims to assist healthcare professionals in ensuring patient safety by identifying and addressing possible contraindications.

requestBody.description: A request to retrieve interactions related to prescriptions. This includes the necessary data in JSON format to specify the details required for the operation.
